environment.description: Terraform provider binary runs as terraform-provider-customapi on a CI/CD runner (Ubuntu 22.04, kernel 5.15). The provider process runs as the 'terraform' user with full network access. The backend target is an nginx reverse proxy (1.22) fronting internal microservices. The provider is invoked during `terraform apply` with user-supplied .tf configurations that specify endpoint_url, custom_headers, and body parameters. No egress filtering or request inspection is applied between the CI runner and the backend proxy.
